raw_snippet: The company said in an email to customers that the entire Cove team is joining Microsoft and the product will shut down on April 1, and all user data will be deleted.
note: Microsoft Corp -> Cove (AI collaboration canvas); sublayer consumer_ai; acquihire; the entire team joined Microsoft and the product shut down on 1 Apr 2026; GeekWire reported that the deal's terms were not disclosed. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
